pokedexEntries.rb: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

pokedexEntries.ye: Its large eyes act as radars. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

pokedexEntries.go: Its eyes also function as radar units. It catches and eats small bugs that hide in darkness.

pokedexEntries.si: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches and eats small bugs at night that are attracted by light.

pokedexEntries.cr: The small bugs it eats appear only at night, so it sleeps in a hole in a tree until night falls.

pokedexEntries.rs: VENONAT is said to have evolved with a coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body for protection. It possesses large eyes that never fail to spot even miniscule prey.

pokedexEntries.fr: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.
